The exact reduced fraction depends on doctrinal interpretation of articles 346-347 + the asaba/Ta'sib mechanics in articles 348-356. This pass refuses to assign a numeric share until a Studio reviewer signs off.
rules.comment: Companion to ma-inh-mother-no-descendants-no-multi-siblings: when the de cujus leaves no descendants but two or more siblings (even when those siblings are themselves excluded by hajb), article 346 explicitly carves out the 1/3 mother case. The reduced share owed to the mother in that scenario is doctrinal (hajb noqsan) and outside this draft's scope.

unsupported_mechanisms.name: hajb
unsupported_mechanisms.label_en: Exclusion of an heir by a closer-degree heir
unsupported_mechanisms.comment: Two flavours: hajb hirman (total exclusion) and hajb noqsan (partial reduction). The mother-with-multi-siblings rule depends on hajb noqsan.

unsupported_mechanisms.name: 'awl
unsupported_mechanisms.label_en: Proportional reduction when fixed shares exceed unity
unsupported_mechanisms.comment: Required whenever the sum of Fardh shares > 1 (e.g. husband 1/2 + 2 sisters 2/3 = 7/6). The current engine has no awl pass.

unsupported_mechanisms.name: radd
unsupported_mechanisms.label_en: Devolution of the residue when no asaba is present
unsupported_mechanisms.comment: Without an asaba heir, the residue is redistributed pro rata among the Fardh heirs (excluding the spouse).

unsupported_mechanisms.name: ta'sib / asaba ordering
unsupported_mechanisms.comment: The current engine uses a sons:daughters 2:1 fixed-residue rule that is correct only for the simple parental-line case. Full asaba ordering involves agnatic/cognatic relatives across multiple degrees.

unsupported_mechanisms.name: kalala
unsupported_mechanisms.comment: Distinct doctrinal regime when the de cujus leaves only siblings.

unsupported_mechanisms.name: applicable_law_decision
unsupported_mechanisms.comment: Whether Moroccan substantive law applies in a cross-border case is decided by Reg. 650/2012; tracked separately by the applicable-law skeleton engine.
